name: Miravete de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Blue field between a white semicircle at the hoist bearing a red cross and a red semicircle at the fly bearing a white Maltese cross, charged at the centre with a yellow tower.
history: Municipal flag of Miravete de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: semicircle at the hoist bearing a red cross
semicircle at the fly bearing a white Maltese cross
